epics.title: Redis API Query Caching with Resilient Fallback
epics.jtbd: When retrieving message histories under high load, I want to cache results in Redis with runtime exception safety, so that database CPU usage and API response times are minimized and no service failures occur.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce average query response times from 300ms to 50ms
requirements: R1: Enable caching on CRM GET /api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages queries with complete exception suppression.

slices.title: Implement Redis API Caching in InboxService
slices.jtbd: When implementing Redis caching for API queries, I want to enable caching on high-frequency GET queries and evict cache entries when the state changes, so that the API remains fast, consistent, and resilient to cache outages.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a positive scenario request to fetch conversation details,
When the messages are retrieved for the first time,
Then they are cached in Redis and subsequent requests are served from the cache.

Given a negative scenario request to fetch conversation details,
When the Redis caching connection fails or times out,
Then the system must gracefully fall back to direct database query without throwing exceptions or propagating failures.

Given an invalid or corrupt cache payload in Redis for a negative scenario,
When the system attempts to deserialize the cached conversation data,
Then it must handle the error, log the exception, and fetch fresh data from the database.

Given an active cached conversation query for an edge case scenario,
When a new manual message is sent or a lead reply is received,
Then the system must evict the corresponding cache entries to prevent serving stale data.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce the stale data serve rate from 100% to 0%
